title: Chapter 1136
paragraphs: Chapter 1136
Episode 259. The Truth of the World, Your Truth, My Truth (5)
At first, I didn't know this place was a dimensional passage.
I wondered if Solderet had failed to turn back time, or if I had also died in the process and arrived in the afterlife.
"Where... is this? Solderet! Solderet!"
For several hours, I had moved forward aimlessly, calling for Solderet.
But no matter how much I walked, the scenery didn't change. Just a pure white landscape, so white that I couldn't even distinguish the floor from the sky.
Even when I opened the recording window, no sentences appeared. I had experienced numerous subspaces while searching for heritage sites, but this was the first time.

I don't know how much time had passed until I realized this place was a dimensional passage. With no day or night, I couldn't read the flow of time, and in my despair, I even deliberately slept. Hoping that when I opened my eyes, the world I knew would appear.
But no matter how much I moved, I didn't feel hungry. I didn't feel tired either. It was the same even when I used my magic to its limit.
While pondering the reason, I suddenly realized that the place was shining all over.
"Light...?"
There was no sky and no sun, but wherever I looked, light was being reflected and was sparkling.

Suddenly, I remembered Solderet's final moments. The way he had shone brightly and been annihilated. And I thought. Perhaps the light that colors this space is Solderet himself? Is it thanks to that light that I don't feel hungry and can use my magic?
Since I wouldn't get hungry or run out of magic, I started using recording magic every day.
My intention was to do so forever until something appeared in the recording window. It was the only thing I could do anyway, and I couldn't give up on life just because I couldn't see a path.
I contemplated the knowledge I had accumulated as a Hister, modified my magic, strengthened it, and made new attempts.
While continuing to use recording magic like that, I was able to confirm a sentence appearing in the window for the first time.
It was the content I had wanted to know first.
It was a result of gaining some enlightenment in recording magic. No one will ever know how happy I was then.
"The turning back of time was a success... and Solderet, has become light again?"
Again.
That word had only one meaning. That his essence was light itself.
I delved into recording magic more and more. I had to find more records to find out how the world was changing and what the way out of here was.
The world had certainly gone back 30 years, and I knew everything. I would also be able to find out why I was the only one trapped in this space, unaffected by the time reversal.
"Wait, Jin. I'm coming. I won't let you fight alone."
I don't know how much more time passed like that.

In my perception, it must have been over a hundred years. Perhaps even hundreds of years. Finally, my recording magic had almost reached the state of mastery, and new records began to appear in the window.
Starting with that one sentence, which was like salvation, I was able to get a glimpse of the records of all dimensions.
But there was a problem.
Although I could look into the records of other dimensions, I still couldn't find a way to get out of here.
I couldn't tell Jin the information I knew.
Moreover, according to my subsequent tracking of Jin's records, it seemed that the record I had left on him was not valid.

However, as I watched Jin's intermittently revealed records, I was able to be sure of one thing. Even if my record was not valid, for some reason, Jin was preserving his memories from before time was turned back. And Solderet too was not completely annihilated, but was just remaining in the form of power and helping him.
"I have to find a way out. If I can't go to the 677th dimension directly in the end, I have to at least find a way to send a message..."
I didn't only pay attention to the 677th dimension.

I was looking into almost all the dimensions that had branched off from Zipple's history manipulation. However, the other dimensions where the 'regressed Jin' did not exist showed a history almost similar to before Solderet had turned back time.

If possible, I wanted to bring about some change in those dimensions as well. As I had already looked into, even if there was no world where Jin and I had a deep connection like in the 677th dimension, a Valeria Hister certainly existed there.
Even without Jin, Valeria Hister had faced death while resisting the Zipples in every world. And every Valeria Hister used recording magic.

Therefore, if only I could send recording magic to that world, and if a small change occurred in that world as a result, someone might be able to look into that record. They might be able to deal a blow to the Demon Army.
A lot more time passed since then.
My first message reached the Valeria Hister of the 233rd dimension. Unfortunately, it seemed she hadn't received the full message, but it seemed the content that the Demon Army existed was conveyed.
Should I call it distance? It was different for each dimension. This place where I was, the dimensional passage, was closest to the 233rd dimension.

I could grasp the distance to other dimensions to some extent by the amount of information flowing into the recording window. The places with the most records coming in were close, and the places with the least records were far.
Unfortunately, the 677th dimension was the farthest. The least amount of information appeared among all those dimensions. It didn't seem to be a coincidence.
I couldn't choose a dimension and leave a message.
It was no different from sending a glass bottle with a note inside out to sea. Praying that it would reach someone, I sent countless messages to other dimensions.
Gray Owl.
The Gray Owl, which the Demon Army called the rebels, was born that way. But in truth, we had never met each other.

The Valerias of other dimensions had just received my message and devised their own ways to deal with the Demon Army. The Valeria of some dimensions had created quite a large force, and the Valeria of some dimensions had acted alone until the end.
That everyone used the name Gray Owl, and that all of them failed in the end.
That was the common point of all the Valerias.
"In the end, the 677th dimension... everything depends on Jin. At this rate, all dimensions except for the one where Jin is will soon be conquered by the Demon Army."

My heart grew anxious as history didn't change even though the messages had started to be delivered. The history of the 677th dimension that occasionally appeared was my only comfort. There, Jin had met another me, and was building a bond with her from early on.
So, it wasn't just a comfort.
It was a strange feeling.
"The Valeria who is in the 677th dimension now... who is she? Is she me? Then the me who is here... what am I?"
It must be called jealousy.
I was feeling jealous of myself. I was envious of her, who was living a new life thanks to Jin, who had the memories of his past life, without knowing anything.
But I had not forgotten my own past. Before time was turned back, my life, before meeting Jin, was just years of dark hatred.
It must be the same for that Valeria. That Valeria, too, would not want to live like that.
"...Let's do what I have to do. These thoughts are of no help in stopping the Demon Army."
Again, a lot of time passed.
And in this distant dimensional passage, for the first time, I saw another person.
"Valeria Hister, so you were hiding here... You must be the leader of the rebels."
Silyn Zipple.

I had been so lonely, yet I had never imagined that the first other person to appear would be a member of the Demon Army. It seemed they had learned several secrets about the dimensional passages while conquering other worlds.
While looking into the records of the world, I had not known what was happening in the dimensional passage where I was.

From then on, I had to navigate the labyrinth of the dimensional passages each time to avoid Zipple's pursuit. At first, I didn't even know how to move in the dimensional passage, so I had to use the traces left by Silyn Zipple.
But if they could find their way here, it meant that I could also go outside.
I was so excited by that fact that I couldn't even feel the pain of my wounds. The wounds, fortunately, healed as the light remaining in the dimensional passage seeped into them.
"I can get out. I have to get out, I have to go to Jin quickly...!"
I analyzed the records left by the Demon Army's pursuers and learned how they navigated the dimensional passages. They were risking becoming lost in the dimensional passages to pursue me.

According to the information they had analyzed with the Origin Stone, the dimensional passage was similar to the Black Sea of the human world. In that the paths changed every time. It seemed that even the Origin Stone couldn't completely analyze the paths of the dimensional passage.
Nevertheless, I recorded a map of the dimensional passage every day to go to other dimensions, if possible, to the 677th dimension directly.
Record, destroy, record, destroy. In the meantime, I read the records of other worlds, guessed the distance to that dimension based on the size of the record, and then fled when the pursuers came.

My life was in danger every moment, but it was better than when I was just sitting still, looking at records and sending messages. Even if they were enemies, at least I didn't feel like I was completely alone in the world.
The first dimension I entered directly was the 262nd dimension.

By then, I had reached a state where I could create matter with magic, and while analyzing the dimensional passage and the light remaining here, I had learned that the light that existed before the 'matter' of the Sun God was Solderet, and the darkness was Helluram. To be precise, they were beings materialized through Kinzelo from light and darkness, so they were not light and darkness themselves.

Anyway, the 262nd dimension had already been conquered by the Demon Army by the time I entered. The outside air, which I had smelled for the first time in a long while, smelled only of blood and ash. I hid my body in the dimensional passage again to escape their pursuit.

Dimensions 12, 31, 632, 55, etc. All the dimensions I entered directly after that were in such a state. Later, I just looked at the situation of that dimension from the passage and didn't enter directly. Because even if I entered, it was under the rule of the Demon Army, so it would only make it easier for Kelliark to track me.
While all the dimensions were falling into Kelliark's hands as in the history I knew.
I finally approached the 677th dimension, which I had so dreamed of. By then, the Valeria of the 677th dimension had already received several of my messages.
But the 677th dimension, unlike the worlds I could enter directly before... I could not enter it directly.
"Why... why only here... can't I enter?"
I muttered to myself with a blank face, but in fact, I knew instinctively.
The Valeria Hister who was currently fighting against the Demon Army with Jin.
She and I could not coexist.
